charts.title: WASP-132 b: orbits around WASP-132
charts.description: The orbits of WASP-132's planets in this map from above, to scale, with WASP-132 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Ivshina & Winn 2022 (2022ApJS..259...62I), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname IVSHINA__AMP__WINN_2022): P 7.1335125 d

charts.title: WASP-132 b: its transit
charts.description: WASP-132 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (38, 65, 102) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 127530399, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 44-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 44-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
